points: Your site promotes free shipping on orders over €85, yet 0 of 29 ads mention shipping or delivery, so new buyers have no reason to click. Put the shipping answer in the first line of three new ads.
None of your 20 ads with fixed copy carries a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing to trust yet. Lead the next batch with one real figure, a review count or orders shipped, in the first line.

3 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage instead of the product on screen, so the click starts over on a general page. Point each of those ads to the product it shows, such as the Miracle Balm page.
